# Momentum

*Price change over N bars.*

**Kind** indicator · **Drawn** in its own pane

## Try it

On the chart, press <kbd>/</kbd> and choose **Momentum** under **Oscillators**. To change it, copy the source below into the AlphaScript editor.

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Length | int | `10` |
| Source | source | `"close"` |
| Color | color | `"#2962FF"` |

## Source

From `packages/alphascript/indicators/momentum.as.js`.

```js
indicator({ name: "Momentum", shortTitle: "Mom", overlay: false });
const length = input.int("Length", 10, { min: 1 });
plot(ta.mom(input.source("Source", "close"), length), { title: "Mom", color: input.color("Color", "#2962FF", { group: "Style" }) });
```
